feedback: The backhand backswing starts too late, so contact happens behind the body and the clear loses depth. Begin preparing the racket as the opponent strikes.
The player does not recover to base after playing at the net, so the back of the court is left open. Push back towards the centre immediately after the lunge.
Good effort on the smash. The player hits hard and looks aggressive in this rally.
The player is standing in the middle of the court wearing a red shirt. The crowd is visible in the background and the rally lasts several shots.
The block sits up too high because the grip is tight and the racket face is square on contact. Relax the fingers and angle the face down to keep it tight to the net.
To improve, the player should keep working on their technique and stay focused during rallies.
The same cross-court clear is repeated from the same position, making it easy to read. Disguise the shot and mix in drops from that preparation.
